info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v4-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Classes API provides a comprehensive overview of available fitness classes for memberships. It allows users to list and discover various classes offered, including schedules and options relevant to their membership type. This endpoint is ideal for developers working on fitness applications or platforms that incorporate class availability for gyms and fitness centers. Consumers can leverage this API to enhance user experience by displaying engaging fitness class information directly to their clients.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of available classes for memberships.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves a comprehensive list of classes that are available for memberships, allowing users to view their options and make informed decisions about their membership selections.
